I've answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. The ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import was attached to that ticket. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so this is information he can already see. In the same post Hollis flagged a mismatch: the import file labelled the doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet used 01/02. I passed that along as it stood in June. I haven't seen anything since saying whether it was fixed.
